entries.summary: Initial release: [oha_education] shortcode pulls live class data from Schedule Hub.
entries.notes: Hero, value cards, sessions grid with instructor headshots and modal, FAQ accordion, CTA strip. All text editable via Settings > Education Hub. Depends on oha-schedule-hub for oha_class CPT.

entries.summary: Auto convention-year detection: Jan-May shows current year, June+ advances to next year
entries.notes: Uses current_time() with June 1 cutoff. Explicit year= attr on shortcode always overrides.

entries.summary: Admin year override setting in Settings > Education Hub lets admin pin a specific convention year
entries.notes: Priority chain: shortcode year= attr > active_year_override setting > auto-detect. Leave blank for auto.

entries.summary: CSS palette aligned to Kadence global palette vars; removed all hardcoded hex colors
entries.notes: Tokens now map to --global-palette1/2/4/6/7/9. Wrapper bg is transparent. Old --oha-orange/--oha-gold renamed to --oha-primary/--oha-accent.

entries.summary: CSS and JS now only load on pages that contain the [oha_education] shortcode
entries.notes: Uses has_shortcode() check in wp_enqueue_scripts hook. Previously loaded unconditionally on all pages.
